title: The Pink Lattice
notes: A celosía painted bougainvillea pink with one green square
address: Bosques de las Lomas, Mexico City

cover.alt: Drawing of the pink lattice with the green square
cover.caption: Study for the lattice.

detail.intro: A celosía is a lattice: a screen that lets light and air through while keeping the inside private. At Casa Meyer the lattice is painted a deep bougainvillea pink, and one of its openings is filled with a single square of bright green.

blocks.html: Barragán's study gives the screen's measurements in centimetres, 299 wide by 277 high, with a door set into the right third. The green square sits beside the door, where a hand reaches for it. The lattice is the house's signature and the starting point for the design of this site. [Photographs of the lattice in place still to come.]
